content.summary: The framing distinguishes the universal conditional I(27) ⇒ G(80), the unconditional two-independent-twenty-star bound, and the ordinary external-I(27) corollary correctly. The fully expanded terminal proposition matches finite distinct four-set families with three distinct sunflower petals and permits empty core. I(27) is an explicit quantified antecedent, not a hidden project axiom in the inspected source and audit receipts. Detailed proof and source-closure verification remain later-phase work.

findings.statement: The abstract, Theorem 3, Corollary 4, and expanded Lean proposition consistently preserve the external I(27) boundary; no unconditional local global-eightyth theorem is asserted.
findings.disposition: Retain the explicit antecedent and external-computation qualification in subsequent versions.

checks.method: Read the frozen manuscript Sections 1, 2 and 5 against FinalEighty.lean and the expanded theorem in FinalEightyAudit.json; unpacked the finite H-cardinality-three and pairwise-intersection clauses.
checks.observation: Both sides quantify all finite families over α : Type with DecidableEq. H.card = 3 supplies distinct petals; core has no nonempty restriction; four-uniformity makes the diagonal clause in the intersecting assumption harmless. The terminal Type interface and the structural Type* interface are disclosed.

checks.scope: No silently assumed I(27) in unconditional two-star theorem
checks.method: Read TwoHighEighty.lean and its printed public theorem; traced the degree-at-most-nineteen hypothesis to the inherited unconditional high-point cap in the wrapper.
checks.observation: The public two-star theorem requires only four-uniformity, sunflower-freeness, distinct centers of degree twenty and no cooccurrence. It has no I(27), finite-support cutoff, or diagnostic premise. The lower-level theorem accepts the other-degree cap, which the public wrapper derives.

checks.scope: Declared axiom boundary and receipt consistency
checks.method: Inspected audit source for theorem/Prop checks and Lean.collectAxioms allow-list; parsed 31 terminal, two-star and Profile-A audit records, and recomputed manuscript, receipt and recorded-output SHA-256 values.
checks.observation: All 31 audit entries report pass with exactly the permitted logical foundation names; all recomputed hashes match. FinalEighty takes hI as a function argument and ProfileAClosed propagates it. This is receipt/source inspection, not a fresh Lean replay or completed dependency-source rebuild.
